field_semantics.scratchpad_hex: 18 lowercase HEX characters, nine bytes in bus byte order; byte0=temp LSB, byte1=temp MSB, byte4=config, byte8=received CRC. TH/TL=4b/46 and reserved=ff/0c/10 are chosen fixture contents, not required universal values.
field_semantics.conversion_completed_for_this_sample: Logical test precondition supplied separately from the frame. True means completion belongs to the current addressed sensor/acquisition, not an old conversion. It cannot be inferred from 85 C or from CRC.
field_semantics.requested_resolution_bits: Resolution chosen in this test context. 9/10/11-bit vectors test the generic frame decoder and do NOT change the project runtime selection of 12 bits or permit a configuration mismatch.
field_semantics.expected_crc_match: CRC8/Maxim of bytes0..7 equals byte8. Correct CRC is necessary but insufficient for frame or sample validity.
field_semantics.expected_format_valid: For these exact nine-byte fixtures, checks only config reserved bits: (byte4 & 0x9f)==0x1f. Not a substitute for ROM, line-state, current-cycle or sample-age checks.
field_semantics.expected_resolution_bits: 9+R1R0 only when configuration is valid. Empty means no valid resolution should be published.
field_semantics.expected_temperature_C: Exact decoded C value only if CRC and configuration are valid; can still be stale. Empty means no valid temperature may be published, not numeric zero.
field_semantics.expected_protocol_sample_usable: Only with CRC+configuration+current conversion+requested resolution matching. Assumes a valid addressed ROM/family/ROM CRC and no expired sample age. Not permission to energize outputs or bypass process safety.

checks.temperature: Two exact rational expressions (signed integer /16 and weighted bit sum /16), checked against literal Table1 reference pairs and independently assigned 25 C resolution cases
checks.crc: Two equivalent but independent arithmetic forms: reflected LSB-first 0x8c recurrence and normal polynomial 0x131 division after byte bit reflection; checked on every frame. Nine-byte zero-residue verification also checked. Three existing project frame literals match exactly.
checks.undefined_bits: All 8 combinations for9-bit, all4 for10-bit and both2 for11-bit at25 C are included; only explicitly undefined temperature bits are ignored, not reserved config bits.
checks.same_bytes_different_validity: DS_T12_PLUS85 and DS_POWERUP_85_NO_CONVERSION have identical nine-byte frames but opposite usability due solely to completed-current-conversion context.
